---
name: Problem or measurement
about: Something went wrong, or you measured your unit (both help)
title: ''
labels: ''
---

**What happened** (or what you measured):

**Firmware**: the version and build on the splash screen (for example `V0.2-BETA.1 AA3ADF34`):

**Diagnostics page 1**: a photo (menu, DIAGNOSTICS). It shows VCC, the chip version, the USB-C guard and the stack.

**Check the unit** (installer page, Advanced, "Check the unit"): what it shows for the chip and the settings area. This tells
whether your unit is the same hardware as the tested one.

**Cells**: LiPo or LiHV, size, how many ports in use, the VOLTAGE and CURRENT settings, ALLOW 4.35V:

**Power**: USB-C (which charger or computer) or XT60 (which pack or supply):

**Multimeter**, if you have one: a full cell measured at its connector after 5 minutes of rest, and what the charger showed for it:

If anything got hot, smoked or swelled: unplug it, put the cell somewhere safe, and say so first.
